observation: The semantic import parser observed static import and require calls but not JavaScript dynamic import('./module'), so real lazy-loaded dependencies were absent from the repository graph.
pre_fix_reproduction: src/main.js using import('./lazy.js') produced no imports edge to src/lazy.js.
change: Extend the existing import pattern to recognize literal relative dynamic import() calls without changing graph architecture or non-relative package resolution.
truth_boundary: Only literal relative dynamic imports are covered. Computed import expressions and complete language/package resolution remain outside this change.
